podcast.body: Rage Against the Machine's "Bulls on Parade" features Tom Morello's distinct use of the wah-wah pedal in full treble position for the riffs, serving as a prime example of its creative application in their music. "Tom Morello with his Wawa pedal in full treble position for the Riffs Throughout Bulls on Parade."
